"""Independent saved-array replay; NEVER imports producer or geometry/engine APIs."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,math,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/Users/nilakarthikesan/.codex/worktrees/partner-simulation-review/grasp-failure-prediction')
BASE=ROOT/'research_artifacts/manosim_orientation_qualification_2026-10-15_v2'
FREEZE='77d736c8653208b2eda115af72588038d687a9f2'
PROTOCOL_SHA='317f216906fe789aa7808aba990ba770ba08a385e7151235bdf91a867d64e921'
E=1e-8;DOT=1e-6;NORMAL=1e-6;OBJECT=1e-7;BANDS=np.array([.001,.002,.005]);PARTS=('palm','index','middle','ring','little','thumb')

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def arr(p):
    with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as z:return {k:z[k] for k in z.files}
def need(ok,message):
    if not bool(ok):raise ValueError(message)
def array_sha(a):return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes()).hexdigest()
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),*args])
def verify_bindings(p):
    for file,digest in p['bindings'].items():need(sha(file)==digest,'Bound source/input changed: '+file)
def verify_file(row):
    p=Path(row['path']);need(p.exists() and sha(p)==row['sha256'] and p.stat().st_size==row['bytes'],'Artifact bytes differ: '+str(p));return p

def same(a,b,message):need(np.array_equal(a,b),message)
def close(a,b,tol,message):
    a,b=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b);need(a.shape==b.shape and np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(b).all(),message+' finite/shape')
    error=float(np.max(np.abs(a-b),initial=0));need(error<=tol,message);return error

def classify(n,m,r,near,far,mnear):
    q=len(r);parts=np.arange(6)[None,:];possible=~far
    valid=n['global_point_valid']&m['global_point_valid']&(n['global_nearest_part']==m['global_nearest_part'])
    valid &= (np.abs(n['global_score'])>DOT)&(np.abs(m['global_score'])>DOT)
    band=(n['global_distance'][:,None]<=BANDS)&(m['global_distance'][:,None]<=BANDS)
    point=valid[:,None,None]&(parts[:,:,None]==n['global_nearest_part'][:,None,None])&band[:,None,:]
    opposite=(n['global_score']*m['global_score'])<0
    reasons={};cellvalid=np.ones((q,6),bool)
    for name,f in (('native',n),('mapped',m)):
        nearest=f['global_nearest_part'][:,None]==parts
        d=f['distance_by_part'];gap=np.sort(d,axis=1)[:,1]-d.min(axis=1)
        reasons[name+'_global_part_unstable']=~nearest|(gap[:,None]<=2*r[:,None]+2*E)
        reasons[name+'_facet_unstable']=(f['cell_candidate_count']!=1)|f['cell_competing_normal']
        reasons[name+'_facet_edge_possible']=f['nearest_facet_edge_clearance_m']<=r[:,None]+E
        reasons[name+'_query_exterior_unproved']=f['query_inside_hand'][:,None]|(f['global_distance'][:,None]-r[:,None]<=E)
        reasons[name+'_closest_exterior_unproved']=f['closest_visual_inside'][:,None]|(f['closest_visual_distance_m'][:,None]-r[:,None]-2*E<=OBJECT)
        reasons[name+'_point_eligibility_unavailable']=np.broadcast_to(~f['global_point_valid'][:,None],(q,6))
        reasons[name+'_facing_sign_ambiguous']=(f['cell_facet_score_min']<=DOT)&(f['cell_facet_score_max']>=-DOT)
    for bad in reasons.values():cellvalid &= ~bad
    stable=possible&near&mnear&cellvalid[:,:,None];flips=stable&opposite[:,None,None]
    status=np.zeros((q,6,3),np.int8);status[possible]=3;status[stable]=1;status[flips]=2
    return dict(orientation_possible_required=possible,point_eligible=point,point_sign_reversal=point&opposite[:,None,None],cell_sign_status=status,
        cell_stable_matching=stable&~flips,cell_sign_reversal=flips,cell_unresolved=possible&~stable,
        **{'cell_reason_'+k:v for k,v in reasons.items()})

def independent_summary(c,area):
    out={}
    for pi,part in enumerate(PARTS):
        out[part]={}
        for bi,b in enumerate((1,2,5)):
            out[part][str(b)]={}
            for key in ('orientation_possible_required','point_eligible','point_sign_reversal','cell_stable_matching','cell_sign_reversal','cell_unresolved'):
                mask=c[key][:,pi,bi];out[part][str(b)][key]=dict(query_count=int(mask.sum()),centroid_area_mm2=float(area[mask].sum()))
    flips=int(c['point_sign_reversal'].sum()+c['cell_sign_reversal'].sum())
    return dict(by_part_and_band=out,reliable_point_sign_reversal_observations=int(c['point_sign_reversal'].sum()),
        reliable_cell_sign_reversal_observations=int(c['cell_sign_reversal'].sum()),unresolved_required_cell_count=int(c['cell_unresolved'].sum()),
        fixed_pose_orientation_status='FAIL' if flips else 'INCOMPLETE',strict_mapping_gate='FAIL' if flips else 'INCOMPLETE',full_orientation_continuous_coverage='NOT_PROVED',
        object_facet_boundary_multinormal_coverage='NOT_PROVED',outward_normals_conditional_on_closed_nonselfintersecting_source=True,area_weights_are_centroid_quadrature=True,
        no_finger_motion_or_physics_claim=True,native_fidelity_accepted=False,new_collection_or_training_allowed=False)

def check_feature(f,g,q,r):
    count=len(r);rows=np.arange(count);labels=g['anatomical_part_index'];tri=g['triangles_object_m']
    need(all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in f.values()),'Nonfinite completed features')
    need(f['distance_by_part'].shape==(count,6),'Full part denominator changed')
    part=f['distance_by_part'].argmin(axis=1);face=f['nearest_face'][rows,part];dist=f['distance_by_part'][rows,part]
    same(f['global_nearest_part'],part,'Chosen global part');same(f['global_nearest_face'],face,'Chosen global face');same(f['global_distance'],dist,'Chosen global distance')
    need(np.all((f['nearest_face']>=0)&(f['nearest_face']<1552)),'Face domain')
    same(labels[f['nearest_face']],np.broadcast_to(np.arange(6),(count,6)),'Anatomical face alignment')
    cross=np.cross(tri[:,1]-tri[:,0],tri[:,2]-tri[:,0]);length=np.linalg.norm(cross,axis=1)
    need((length>1e-15).all(),'Undropped facet degeneracy')
    volume=float(np.sum(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',tri[:,0],np.cross(tri[:,1],tri[:,2]),optimize=False))/6)
    need(abs(volume)>1e-9,'Outward volume sign unavailable')
    normal=cross/length[:,None]*(1 if volume>0 else -1)
    normalerror=close(f['normal_by_part'],normal[f['nearest_face']],1e-14,'Saved facet normal arithmetic')
    on=q['visual_triangle_outward_normal'];score=-np.einsum('ij,ij->i',normal[face],on,optimize=False)
    scoreerror=close(f['global_score'],score,1e-14,'Facing score arithmetic')
    need(np.all(f['point_tie_count']>=1) and np.all(f['cell_candidate_count']>=f['point_tie_count']),'All-tie/candidate cardinality nesting')
    part_scores=-np.einsum('qpc,qc->qp',f['normal_by_part'],on,optimize=False)
    need(np.all(f['point_tie_score_min']<=part_scores+1e-14) and np.all(f['point_tie_score_max']>=part_scores-1e-14),'Every chosen normal lies inside full point-tie dot interval')
    need(np.all(f['point_tie_score_min']<=f['point_tie_score_max']) and np.all(f['cell_facet_score_min']<=f['cell_facet_score_max']),'Tie dot interval ordering')
    need(np.all(f['cell_facet_score_min']<=f['point_tie_score_min']+1e-14) and np.all(f['cell_facet_score_max']>=f['point_tie_score_max']-1e-14),'Point ties contained by cell candidates')
    same(f['query_inside_hand'],np.abs(f['query_winding'])>.5,'Saved winding classification')
    same(f['closest_visual_inside'],np.abs(f['closest_visual_winding'])>.5,'Saved visual winding classification')
    reasons=dict(query_inside_hand=f['query_inside_hand'],query_on_hand_boundary=dist<=E,outside_5mm_band=dist>.005,
        competing_normal=f['point_competing_normal'][rows,part],multiple_closest_points=f['point_competing_position'][rows,part],
        competing_part=np.sum(f['distance_by_part']<=dist[:,None]+E,axis=1)>1,
        point_facing_interval_ambiguous=(f['point_tie_score_min'][rows,part]<=DOT)&(f['point_tie_score_max'][rows,part]>=-DOT),
        closest_inside_or_on_visual=f['closest_visual_inside']|(f['closest_visual_distance_m']<=OBJECT),
        invalid_hand_or_object_normal=(np.abs(np.linalg.norm(on,axis=1)-1)>NORMAL)|(np.abs(np.linalg.norm(normal[face],axis=1)-1)>NORMAL),
        half_winding_unreliable=(np.abs(np.abs(f['query_winding'])-.5)<1e-3)|(np.abs(np.abs(f['closest_visual_winding'])-.5)<1e-3))
    for key,value in reasons.items():same(f['reason_'+key],value,'Point eligibility reason '+key)
    same(f['global_point_valid'],~np.logical_or.reduce(list(reasons.values())),'Complete all-tie point eligibility')
    return dict(query_count=count,six_parts_retained=True,all_tie_interval_and_ambiguity_predicates_replayed=True,
        maximum_saved_normal_arithmetic_error=normalerror,maximum_saved_facing_dot_arithmetic_error=scoreerror,
        signed_volume_m3=volume,point_valid_count=int(f['global_point_valid'].sum()),
        all_triangle_tie_enumeration_not_independently_requeried=True)

def main():
    protocol=BASE/'protocol.json';reportpath=BASE/'run_v1/report.json';need(reportpath.exists(),'Wait for frozen actual report before verifying')
    need(sha(protocol)==PROTOCOL_SHA,'Active protocol identity');p=read(protocol);report=read(reportpath)
    need(len(p['bindings'])==3958 and len(p['tracked_sources'])==147,'Frozen closure cardinality')
    need(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==FREEZE,'HEAD hold');verify_bindings(p)
    for file in [*p['tracked_sources'],str(protocol)]:
        blob=git('show',FREEZE+':'+str(Path(file).relative_to(ROOT)));need(hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==sha(file),'Committed source/protocol bytes')
    need(report['freeze_commit']==FREEZE and report['protocol_sha256']==PROTOCOL_SHA,'Report lineage')
    started=read(BASE/'run_v1/STARTED.json');need(started==dict(freeze_commit=FREEZE,protocol_sha256=PROTOCOL_SHA),'Once-run STARTED lineage')
    need([r['index'] for r in report['cases']]==[20,28],'Allcase order/denominators')
    inventory={};array_inventory={};cases=[]
    def index_file(path):
        path=Path(path).resolve();inventory[str(path)]=dict(sha256=sha(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size)
    index_file(protocol);index_file(reportpath);index_file(BASE/'run_v1/STARTED.json')
    for row in report['cases']:
        index=row['index'];spec=p['cases'][str(index)]
        need(row['status']=='COMPLETED' and row['returncode']==0,'Completed case required; preserve failures separately')
        for key in ('result','raw_result','log'):verify_file(row[key]);index_file(row[key]['path'])
        need(Path(row['result']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(row['raw_result']['path']).read_bytes(),'Raw/tracked scalar byte copies')
        result=read(row['result']['path']);need(result['status']=='COMPLETED_SAVED_ORIENTATION_DIAGNOSTIC','Completed child status')
        need(result['source_inventory_index']==index and result['freeze_commit']==FREEZE and result['protocol_sha256']==PROTOCOL_SHA,'Child identity')
        need(result['physical_outcome'] is None and result['admission_allowed'] is False and result['native_fidelity_accepted'] is False and result['new_collection_or_training_allowed'] is False,'No outcome/admission promotion')
        need(result['failure'] is None and not result.get('post_validation_failure') and not result['unindexed_partial_files'],'Completed failure inventory')
        need(all(v==0 for v in result['forbidden_operations'].values()),'Zero engine/model/physics/inference/fitting')
        need([(s['stage'],s['status']) for s in result['stages']]==[('native','COMPLETED'),('compiled','COMPLETED')],'Both full surfaces, no incomplete stage')
        counts=result['query_work_counts'];limits=spec['limits'];need(set(counts)==set(limits),'Counter inventory')
        for k,v in counts.items():need(0<=v<=limits[k] and (v==limits[k] or k=='object_winding_triangle_tests'),'Complete charged work '+k)
        need(result['elapsed_s']<=600,'Frozen wall clock')
        artifacts=result['artifacts'];paths=set();byname={};chunks={'native':[],'compiled':[]}
        raw=(Path(p['raw_root'])/str(index)).resolve()
        for a in artifacts:
            path=verify_file(a);need(path.resolve().is_relative_to(raw) and path.resolve() not in paths and not path.is_symlink(),'Artifact containment/uniqueness');paths.add(path.resolve());index_file(path)
            values=arr(path);need(set(values)==set(a['arrays']),'Exact creation-time array inventory')
            for k,v in values.items():
                meta=a['arrays'][k];need(meta==dict(shape=list(v.shape),dtype=str(v.dtype),sha256=array_sha(v)),'Creation-time array bytes '+k)
            array_inventory[str(path)]=a['arrays'];byname[path.name]=values
            if a['label'].startswith('orientation_chunk_'):chunks[a['label'].split('orientation_chunk_')[1]].append((path,values))
        need({x.resolve() for x in raw.rglob('*.npz')}==paths,'Every actual NPZ indexed exactly once')
        q=arr(spec['query']['path']);frozen={stage:arr(spec['inputs'][prefix+'_field.npz']['path']) for stage,prefix in [('native','native_reference'),('compiled','compiled_locked_native_surface')]}
        feature_receipts={}
        for stage,prefix in [('native','native_reference'),('compiled','compiled_locked_native_surface')]:
            full=byname[stage+'_features.npz'];chunkrows=sorted(chunks[stage],key=lambda x:x[0].name);cursor=0
            need(len(chunkrows)==math.ceil(spec['query_count']/128),'Every bounded chunk present')
            for path,values in chunkrows:
                _,start,stop=path.stem.split('_');start,stop=int(start),int(stop);need(start==cursor and stop==min(cursor+128,spec['query_count']),'Ordered contiguous full-grid chunks')
                need(set(values)==set(full),'Chunk/full array inventory')
                for k,v in values.items():same(v,full[k][start:stop],'Chunk/full exact bytes '+k)
                cursor=stop
            need(cursor==spec['query_count'],'No query dropped')
            g=arr(spec['inputs'][prefix+'_geometry.npz']['path']);feature_receipts[stage]=check_feature(full,g,q,frozen[stage]['cell_radius_m'])
            field=frozen[stage];same(q['query_object_m'],field['query_object_m'],'Unchanged original query grid')
            need(q['native_distance_by_part_m'].shape==(spec['query_count'],8) and np.isposinf(q['native_distance_by_part_m'][:,6:]).all(),'Exact historical8slotcache')
            same(q['native_distance_by_part_m'][:,:6],field['native_distance_by_part_m'],'Unchanged native field target')
            target=field['native_distance_by_part_m'] if stage=='native' else field['mapped_distance_by_part_m']
            feature_receipts[stage]['distance_readback_max_error_m']=close(full['distance_by_part'],target,1e-12,'Frozen literal distance readback')
            need(feature_receipts[stage]['distance_readback_max_error_m']==result['stages'][0 if stage=='native' else 1]['maximum_distance_readback_error_m'],'Recorded distance arithmetic scalar')
        same(frozen['native']['cell_radius_m'],frozen['compiled']['cell_radius_m'],'Original cell radius unchanged')
        same(frozen['native']['native_near'],frozen['compiled']['native_near'],'Original relationship masks unchanged')
        r=frozen['native']['cell_radius_m'];mnear=frozen['compiled']['mapped_distance_by_part_m'][:,:,None]+r[:,None,None]+E<=BANDS
        expected=classify(byname['native_features.npz'],byname['compiled_features.npz'],r,frozen['native']['native_near'],frozen['native']['native_far'],mnear)
        compared=byname['comparison.npz'];need(set(expected)==set(compared),'Exact all-site/part/band classification inventory')
        for k,v in expected.items():same(v,compared[k],'Independent full-grid orientation predicate '+k)
        summary=independent_summary(expected,q['area_mm2']);need(summary==result['measurement'],'Independent every-count/area/summary replay')
        cases.append(dict(index=index,result_sha256=row['result']['sha256'],query_count=spec['query_count'],features=feature_receipts,summary=summary,
            work_counts=counts,creation_time_npz_count=len(artifacts),physical_outcome=None))
    need(report['status']=='COMPLETED_SAVED_FULL_GRID_ORIENTATION_PILOT' and report['publication_failure'] is None,'Actual complete report')
    need(report['physical_outcome'] is None and report['admission_allowed'] is False and report['native_fidelity_accepted'] is False and report['new_collection_or_training_allowed'] is False,'Final admission flags')
    verify_bindings(p);need(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==FREEZE,'Final HEAD hold')

    source=Path(__file__).read_text();receipt=dict(schema_version='manosim_full_grid_orientation_v2_independent_saved_readback_v1',status='VERIFIED_COMPLETED_SAVED_ORIENTATION_FULL_GATE_INCOMPLETE',
        freeze_commit=FREEZE,active_protocol_sha256=PROTOCOL_SHA,report_sha256=sha(reportpath),expected_bindings=3958,selected_Git_blobs=148,
        all_bindings_verified_before=True,all_bindings_verified_after=True,artifact_inventory=inventory,array_inventory=array_inventory,cases=cases,
        verification_engine_model_FK_geometry_distance_orientation_query_calls=0,physical_outcome=None,native_fidelity_accepted=False,new_collection_or_training_allowed=False,
        limitations=['All saved eligibility, tied-normal interval, ambiguity, classifications and summaries independently replayed; all-triangle nearest/tie enumeration remains source-bound and was not geometrically requeried',
        'Only fixed saved poses20/28; no motion/contact-force/physical calibration or full continuous orientation acceptance'],
        verifier_source=source,verifier_source_sha256=sha(__file__),errors=[])
    output=BASE/'run_v1/independent_readback.json'
    with output.open('x') as stream:json.dump(receipt,stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=receipt['status'],cases=[dict(index=c['index'],point_reversals=c['summary']['reliable_point_sign_reversal_observations'],unresolved_cells=c['summary']['unresolved_required_cell_count']) for c in cases],sha256=sha(output))))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
